How to Play

Pong — with spells
Guard your tower. Break theirs.
Move to block what comes at you — anything that slips past hits your tower.
Topple the enemy tower to win the round.
Advance — or fall back
The battle is a tug of war across five stages.
Win a round to push into enemy territory. Lose and you get pushed back.
Break through at the enemy core to win the match.
Mana is momentum
Spells cost mana — and the losing side draws more.
Parry a spell to send it back faster and steal 1 mana.
Towers regrow health over time, so press your advantage.
Controls
Keyboard
W / SMove up / down
1 / 2 / 3Cast spells
QUltimate (Juice) when the bar is full
SpaceParry an incoming spell
Controller
Stick / D-padMove up / down
X / A / BCast spells
YUltimate (Juice)
RBParry an incoming spell
